input: # Non-Misc content around the document element: XML 1.0 2.1 says
#   document ::= prolog element Misc*
# so only comments, PIs and white space may sit outside the root. The base
# tabnas engine is a lenient JSON-family lexer, so the standing worry is that
# ITS notion of top-level content (stray punctuation, `#` / `//` / `/* */`
# comments) reaches through @tabnas/xml into this plugin.
# It does not. Every row here is REJECTED by both runtimes as of
# 2026-08-09, and these rows exist to keep it that way: `test/spec/
# xml-layer.tsv` already pins `<feed/><extra/>` and `<feed/>junk`, but not
# the engine-comment or stray-punctuation forms, which are the ones that
# would come back if the xml layer ever relaxed again.
# STILL OPEN, deliberately not a row here because it would be red:
#   <?xml version="1.0"?><?xml version="1.0"?><feed .../>
# A second XML declaration is accepted. XML 1.0 2.6 reserves the `xml` PI
# target and 2.8 allows a declaration only as the first thing in the
# document. Add the row when the parser rejects it.
# --- content after the document element ----------------------------------
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>x</title></feed> trailing
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: <rss version="2.0"><channel/></rss>garbage
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: <feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>}
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: <feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>,
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: # --- engine line/block comment syntax BEFORE the document element --------
# `#`, `//` and `/* */` are jsonic/tabnas comment forms, not XML prolog Misc.
# c\n<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: // c\n<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: /* c */<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: # --- engine line comment syntax AFTER the document element ---------------
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>// x
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element

input: <feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>\n# x
expected: ERROR:character data is not allowed outside the root element
